Change shape_raw/shape_paragraph to take a borrowed run view (range plus &TextStyle) so clip_runs only computes ranges, or build the clipped runs once into a reused Vec and overwrite only the last range end per iteration.

Hoist the buffer out of the loop and reuse it: let mut candidate = String::with_capacity(text.len() + 3); then inside the loop candidate.clear(); candidate.push_str(&text[..end]); candidate.push('\u{2026}');
